claim: The Amazon Managed Grafana Enterprise Plugins license costs an additional $45 per active user per workspace; if you upgrade a workspace with Enterprise Plugins, this additional fee is charged per active user per month.

evidence.quote: To access Enterprise Plugins to connect to third-party Enterprise data sources listed here, an Amazon Managed Grafana Enterprise Plugins license costs an additional $45 per active user per workspace.
If you upgrade your workspace with Amazon Managed Grafana Enterprise Plugins, you will be charged an additional fee per active user per month.
